The Vietnamese translation 'ăn hộp cơm của tôi' (eating my lunch box) completely omits the specific detail about the *type* of food (grass/vegetables) which is crucial for the subsequent joke about her only eating lettuce. It translates the object (lunch box) but drops the key semantic content of the verb phrase.
